rawSpeech.description: The raw verbal input spoken by the user before any STT correction.

stt.description: The speech-to-text transcription output including mistakes/phonetic noise.

normalized.description: The text normalized to clean lowercased words.

fen.description: The FEN representation of the current board state.

legalMoves.description: List of all legal moves (SAN notation) in the current board state.

correctMove.description: The correct target move in SAN notation.

piece.description: Lowercase symbol of the moving piece (p, n, b, r, q, k, or empty for castling).

originFile.description: The starting file constraint (a-h or empty).

originRank.description: The starting rank constraint (1-8 or empty).

capture.description: Whether the move is a capture.

promotion.description: The promotion piece symbol (q, r, b, n or empty).

castle.description: Type of castling: k (kingside), q (queenside), or empty.

reason.description: Natural language rationale detailing why this is the correct move under board legality context.
